name: Cascade Biotech Biometric Scan Gloves
description:
Medical-grade gloves with embedded biometric sensors across all ten fingertips. Touching a patient provides instant readings — pulse, blood oxygen, skin conductivity, temperature, and basic toxicology screening through dermal micro-sampling. Data streams to a connected display or AR overlay in real time.

Used by field medics, triage teams, and the kind of back-alley clinicians who can't afford dedicated scanning equipment. A single touch tells you if someone is dying and roughly what's killing them.
functionality: Contact biometric scanning, toxicology screening, real-time data streaming
what_it_says: You diagnose people by touching them, which is either reassuring or terrifying depending on the context.
story_hooks: A field medic's Biometric Scan Gloves record a patient's vitals showing a heartbeat pattern that matches no known human cardiac rhythm — but the patient appears perfectly healthy.
related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions Pulse Carbine PC-6 'Heartbeat'

physical_description.visual_profile: Sleek medical glove with a clinical yet cybernetic edge—fitted hand coverage with subtle metallic accents at fingertips. Appears almost ordinary at first glance, but closer inspection reveals embedded sensor nodes that catch light. Suggests competence and invasive intimacy.
physical_description.fit: Precision-fitted, second-skin compression that allows dexterous finger articulation without bulk. Snug around wrist with a slight flare to accommodate bracers or augmentation interfaces.
physical_description.primary_material: Medical-grade synthetic polymer with conductive graphene-weave underlayer and biosensor integration. Breathable mesh panels across knuckles and palm sides.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, slightly tacky surface designed for grip without slipping. Fingertips have raised micro-nodules where sensors sit. Wrist band features subtle ribbing for secure fastening. Overall: clinical, precise, slightly cold to touch.
physical_description.color_scheme: Sterile white base with gunmetal grey and teal accent lines running along fingertips and wrist band. Small Cascade Biotech logo (circular, minimalist) in corner of back hand. Optional variations: gunmetal silver for high-tier clinics, salvage grey for sub-grade practitioners.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic closure band at wrist with secondary friction-fit velcro backup. Allows quick removal while maintaining seal integrity.
distinctive_features: Embedded biometric sensors at all ten fingertips with visible micro-circuitry
Conductive threading for AR/display connection at wrist junction
Micro-sampling ports on index and middle fingertips for toxicology
Real-time data transmission indicator (subtle LED pinprick on palm)
Reinforced fingertip nodes resistant to bodily fluids and contamination
Ergonomic sensor calibration markers visible under certain light
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 medical equipment—accessible to licensed clinics and field response teams, but out of reach for street-level sub-grade practitioners unless salvaged or black-market sourced.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by field medics, triage coordinators, corporate wellness officers, and unlicensed back-alley doctors. Signals medical authority, invasive knowledge, and the ability to read a person's body like an open file. Wearing these says: 'I know what's wrong with you before you finish your first breath.'
physical_description.condition_typical: Professional clinics keep them pristine; field medics show wear at fingertips and wrist band from constant use. Black-market variants are patched, recalibrated, or running on degraded sensors. Deep staining from blood and bodily fluids is common—often not fully cleaned due to hazmat protocols.
